principles.title: Open calculations. Clear boundaries.
principles.description: Mingpan is not another fortune-telling bot. It supplies reproducible chart facts and leaves contextual, human interpretation to the AI you choose.

items.title: Inspectable
items.description: Source code, calculation conventions and tool parameters are open to inspection by version.

items.title: No personal archive
items.description: The official MCP is stateless and does not build a birth-profile database. Check your client’s data policy separately.

items.title: Your AI, your interpretation
items.description: No life conclusions, and no promise of free AI access. Choose the client and model that suit you.

capabilities.title: Natal charts, timing cycles, and divination through one endpoint
capabilities.description: Every tool returns structured text designed for AI consumption. Mingpan deliberately avoids fortune scores, pattern verdicts, and life conclusions.

items.title: BaZi
items.description: Four pillars, ten gods, hidden stems, na yin, growth stages, decade luck, and annual, monthly, and daily cycles.

items.title: Zi Wei Dou Shu
items.description: Twelve palaces, major and auxiliary stars, four transformations, five-element bureau, and multi-level timing cycles.

items.title: LiuYao
items.description: Primary and transformed hexagrams, Najia, six relatives, six spirits, host/guest lines, void, and hidden spirits.

items.title: MeiHua YiShu
items.description: Time- or number-based casting with primary, mutual, transformed hexagrams and body–function relations.

items.title: Da Liu Ren
items.description: Derives calendar primitives from Gregorian time and returns the heaven–earth plate, four lessons, three transmissions, and generals.

items.title: Qi Men Dun Jia
items.description: Multiple chart styles and intercalation methods, with the nine-palace chart and deterministic yong-shen facts by subject.

capabilities.calendarNote: Plus 2 calendar primitives: precise times for the 24 solar terms and Gregorian–lunar conversion.

connect.title: Copy the endpoint. Complete the connection.
connect.description: Use a Remote MCP / Streamable HTTP client. Mingpan needs no key; your AI client may have its own fees.

remote.title: Official remote service
remote.description: Stateless pure computation: no chart database, no logging of birth parameters or results. Currently free for fair use.

local.title: Local stdio (optional)
local.description: Calculation runs locally. A cloud-based AI client may still send the results to its provider. Requires Node.js.

connect.note: Per-client configuration locations and examples live in the GitHub README.
steps: Add a remote HTTP MCP server
Paste the endpoint; no API key
Check the tool list, then try fictional data
connect.check: Use /mcp in Claude Code to inspect the connection and tools. If unavailable, check the transport and URL first.
connect.troubleBody: Include /mcp in the URL. The client needs remote HTTP support, not just stdio. Retry later after temporary errors or rate limiting. Copying is not a connection test.
connect.successCheck: The tool list should include bazi_basic and ziwei_basic. With the fictional input below, expect these four pillars: 庚午 · 辛巳 · 庚辰 · 辛巳.

examples.title: Try these after connecting
items: Use Mingpan bazi_basic for a fictional male born 1990-05-15 at 10:00, timezone Asia/Taipei. Return the four pillars first, without interpreting them.
Find the exact time of LiChun in 2027 and explain whether it changes the year pillar for this birth chart.
Cast a Qi Men Dun Jia hourly chart for June 21, 2024 at 10:00. List the computed facts before interpreting them.
